findings.reason: naming the head arm's (or both arms') cold roadmap in the protected order and the completion floor is a one-line change that closes the drop of the plan's third target.
findings.text: §6's fixed order runs the base arm's cold roadmap first and "the remaining cold reads" last, and its completion floor ("not complete until the base arm's cold roadmap and both arms' warm roadmap and audit have run") names only the control and the warm targets; the head arm's cold roadmap carries the plan's third declared target ("a cold roadmap under the 30 s MCP deadline"), so a run whose hour runs out after the warm reads can declare itself complete with that target never run — the same failure the reordering was added to prevent, and it cannot be attributed afterward because no dump exists for a read that did not run

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — the cited profiler (health-tool-latency/scripts/profile_reads.py) resolves under the health-review-1010 report directory, and §7, §8, §10–§14, §16 and §17 all resolve as sections.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §6's done-when is measurable (cold/warm medians of three reads beside the §1 figures) and names a declared negative control, the base revision measured the same way in the same session which must exceed the 30 s deadline.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §6 writes the log, every .prof dump and the pinned corpus revision into the run directory, a durable path, and copies them off node-local scratch before the job ends.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §6 introduces no code symbols, and its write path is the run directory, so no plan label or version tag reaches source.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — the added fixed read order and completion floor protect the control and the two warm targets but leave the plan's third target, the head arm's cold roadmap, out of both, so a run that exhausts the hour after the warm reads can complete with that target never measured.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §6 carries one deliverable, a measurement with attribution of any missed target.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §6's prerequisites (§2–§5 and the read fixes §8, §10–§14, §16, §17) all exist as sections, and the open followup f-araiid-remeasure routes §6 with that same landed set.
